chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-ibn al-Hasan ibn Shamoun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Misma’ Abu Sayyar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whenever one of you intends to go to his wife, so he should not rush it'.
ai.seo_question: What is the prophetic etiquette regarding intimacy with one's spouse?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophetic emphasis on foreplay and gradual intimacy, reflecting the Shia scholarly tradition that views marital relations as an act of worship requiring mindfulness and affection. It underscores the importance of not rushing the process, thereby fostering emotional and physical connection between spouses.
